blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Deputy Minority Leader and ACT Teachers Rep. Antonio Tinio on Thursday, Sept. 17, described the P500 increase in monthly allowance received by state workers in 2027 “woefully inadequate” after nearly 17-year impasse. Tinio said the P500-hike to the Personnel Economic Relief Allowance (Pera) was not enough, primarily amid rising commodity costs. He raised that only P11.79 billion from the P55.865-billion Miscellaneous Personnel Benefits Fund (MPBF) was allotted to the program. His remarks came after the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) affirmed last Tuesday, Sept. 15, that an increase in Pera will be scheduled next year. READ: Solon […]...
